metadata.title: Analytic quantum invariants
metadata.abstract: Using a deformed Borel-Laplace resummation, we propose a framework for repackaging quantum invariants as analytic invariants. We illustrate our approach through a detailed analysis of the coloured Jones polynomials of several simple knots, deriving explicit expressions for the resulting analytic invariants in terms of $(q,X)$-series. These invariants are closely related to, but generally distinct from, those obtained via the conventional Borel resummation of the Melvin-Morton-Rozansky expansion. As a further example, we construct an analytic invariant from a sequence of two-variable polynomials conjectured to be the Links-Gould polynomials of the figure-eight knot, associated with the quantum superalgebras $U_q(\mathfrak{gl}(n|1))$. Finally, we apply our technique to $q$-series arising in the study of three-manifold invariants, revealing connections with mock modular forms.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 用变形 Borel–Laplace 重求和把量子不变量重组为分析不变量，计算若干简单结的彩色 Jones 例子，并讨论三流形 q 级数与 mock 模形式的联系。
analysis.breakthrough: 提供不同于通常 MMR 重求和的分析化机制及可计算实例。
analysis.limitations: 部分 Links–Gould 输入本身是猜想，框架中的提议与已证实例应分开理解。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 协助计算、推导和文字编辑；另用 Mathematica 作符号计算，普通软件使用本身不计为 AI。

analysis.priorityReason: 对量子拓扑与复分析交叉读者有吸引力，但需要逐项检查定义与收敛范围。
